objective: Select a 3-connected triangulated minimum-counterexample representative and prove planar same-side folding and boundary reachability constraints.

atomic_claims.text: If a counterexample exists, one of minimum order and maximum size is a 3-connected planar triangulation.
The two neighbors on any semidegree-two side of a minimum counterexample are joined by a directed two-edge path after deleting the center.
Alternating different-color boundary paths are incompatible; same-color crossing paths force cross-rerouted reachabilities. Degree-five 2+3 blocking obeys the resulting interval restriction.

assumptions: Global minimum vertex count in the full frozen planar-orientation class.
Secondary maximum arc count only for the chosen representative.
C01-C04 proof-draft premises; basic sphere separation and planar minor closure.
risks: Not an exclusion of two-cuts in every minimum counterexample.
No claim of 4-connectivity, arc-criticality or a discharging contradiction.
Boundary conditions are necessary, not a characterization of realizable colorings.
No mathematical command execution or verifier receipt.
